images.prompt: Create a PRODUCTION MODULAR SPRITE COMPONENT KIT derived from the reference boss design. Detailed HQ arcade pixel art, hard metal highlights, black chrome biomechanical alien styling. Transparent background. This is an EXPLODED PARTS KIT, NOT animation poses or assembled characters. EXACTLY 6 isolated components in a strict 3-column x 2-row grid of equal square cells, one component per cell, centered with 12% transparent padding. No text, no labels, no grid lines. Keep all parts facing camera in the same front/slightly top-down view, weapons pointing straight downward. Round overlapping joint caps at sockets allow assembly and pivoting. No other modules baked onto the central hull. Reading order: 1 central elongated helicopter alien hull with rotor hub but NO ROTOR, NO SIDE WEAPON PODS, just compact exposed circular attachment sockets; 2 separate left autocannon pod with shoulder socket on top, muzzle on bottom; 3 matching separate right autocannon pod; 4 separate left triple rocket rack; 5 separate right triple rocket rack; 6 separate narrow tail/rear stabilizer. Preserve the reference red reactor channels and dark chrome, curved alien cable skin. Hull should occupy most of cell height. Cannon/rack parts complete disconnected objects with no attached hull.
